about: Tennis, observation -> finished scene (docs/HANDOFF_EN.md section 6, review F-02/F-03). This half is a written recipe: the stages are still scripts, run in this order with these values; the scene -> V2V half is executable (v2v.json, vrecon pipeline-v2v). Turning these stages into functions under src/vrecon/pipeline is the rest of WP-5. Every per-clip value carries its basis.

video.basis: observation: the clip shipped with GVHMR (D8: research use, not published)

floor_masks.tool: SAM 3.1 on ComfyUI (gpu/h3_control/comfy_sam.py --prompt 'floor, ground, tennis court')

focal_px.basis: measured: court line calibration (scripts/calibrate_court.py), fixed afterwards

court_template.value: ITF singles/doubles court 10.97 x 23.77 m, net 12.8 x 1.07 m

crowd_density.basis: llm: venue layout answer, kept from fal2c

venue_layout.basis: llm: claude -p over the observation summary (scripts/llm_venue.py)

after_strike.basis: human: a serve into the service box (rules of tennis, typical speed)

stages.output: GVHMR person on scene rays, other people as figures, clothing colours
unseen space filled, source view protected
shapes, floor check, clay references, crops, prompts, generation
